The length of time that one has existed in completed years, months and days at the time of the event.  [Explanatory Comment 1: Age is calculated as the Event Date - Person Birth Date. The transfer format of Years, Months and Days (YYY.MM.DD) includes values for year between 0 and 999, for month between 0 and 11, and for day between 0 and 30.  Explanatory Comment 2: The majority of external standards does not represent, transmit, or store the concept of Age. An algorithm is included to provide guidance for the computation of age value.]
